describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in side profile facing right against a plain light background. Its entire body except for the dorsal surface is covered in dense, long, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the legs and lighter on the muzzle and sides. The head is bear-like with a long snout. A single large glossy dark reddish-brown curved horn projects from the forehead. The back and shoulders are covered by a large, highly glossy, dark brown beetle-like exoskeleton consisting of a ridged oval shell over the mid and hind back and a spiky shield over the shoulders, with a row of small circular openings visible along the lower edge where the shell meets the fur.

Its back is covered by a large glossy dark brown beetle-like shell with a smaller glossy shield over the shoulders, with a row of small round holes in the fur below the shell edge. A long curved glossy dark beetle-like horn rises from its forehead between small rounded bear ears.
